An NMOS input pair avoids PMOS input-headroom failure at VCM=0.9 V. Currents are ratio-mirrored from IREF: tail 3x, CS load 4x, plus 2x overhead, giving 9*IREF = 18 uA (about 32 uW) assuming IREF = 2 uA. Small CS and inverter nodes keep the I/C slewing sub-ns."}

```python
# SPECTRA design program
# Signal path: vinp/vinn -> 5T NMOS preamp (outn is the mirror-side output, non-inverting
# w.r.t. vinp) -> NMOS CS stage (inverting) -> CMOS inverter (inverting) => vout HIGH when vinp > vinn.

VDD = 1.8
IREF_DEFAULT = 2e-6       # assumed testbench IREF; total power scales with it
CG_PER_UM = 1.4e-15       # approx gate cap per um of width at L = 0.15 um

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (16, 10, 20),       # preamp NMOS pair gm/Id (high -> low Vdsat, tail stays saturated)
    "L_in":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),    # preamp pair length
    "gmid_ld": (10, 5, 16),        # preamp PMOS mirror-load gm/Id
    "L_ld":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),    # preamp PMOS load length (gain)
    "gmid_cs": (12, 5, 18),        # CS NMOS gm/Id
    "L_cs":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),  # CS NMOS length (short -> small node C -> fast)
    "gmid_cl": (10, 5, 16),        # CS PMOS load and bias-diode gm/Id
    "L_cl":    (0.5, 0.3, 2.0),    # CS PMOS load length
    "kt":      (3.0, 1.0, 5.0),    # tail current ratio: Itail = kt * IREF
    "kb":      (4.0, 1.0, 6.0),    # CS load current ratio: Ics = kb * IREF
    "Wn_inv":  (1.0, 0.42, 10.0),  # output inverter NMOS width (um, L = 0.15)
    "Wp_inv":  (2.0, 0.42, 20.0),  # output inverter PMOS width (um, L = 0.15)
}


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", IREF_DEFAULT)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-14)

    Itail = p["kt"] * iref
    Ihalf = 0.5 * Itail
    Ics = p["kb"] * iref

    # ---- bias: IREF diode (ibias) and mirrors with the same L and gm/Id as the reference ----
    m_ref = lut.size("n", 10, 0.5, iref, vds=0.6)                      # ibias diode
    m_tail = lut.size("n", 10, 0.5, Itail, vds=0.3)                    # tail sink
    m_pbsink = lut.size("n", 10, 0.5, iref, vds=0.6)                   # sinks iref from pb
    m_pbd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_cl"], p["L_cl"], iref, vds=0.9)      # PMOS diode on pb
    m_cl = lut.size("p", p["gmid_cl"], p["L_cl"], Ics, vds=0.9)        # CS PMOS load

    # ---- preamp: NMOS pair + PMOS diode/mirror load ----
    m_in_p = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ihalf, vds=0.5)
    m_in_n = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], Ihalf, vds=0.5)
    m_ld_d = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ihalf, vds=0.9)
    m_ld_m = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], Ihalf, vds=0.9)

    # ---- common-source gain stage ----
    m_cs = lut.size("n", p["gmid_cs"], p["L_cs"], Ics, vds=0.5)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_ref)
    n.dev("MTAIL", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_tail)
    n.dev("MPBS", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_pbsink)
    n.dev("MPBD", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m_pbd)
    n.dev("MCL", "out5", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m_cl)
    n.dev("MINP", "outp", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m_in_p)
    n.dev("MINN", "outn", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m_in_n)
    n.dev("MLDD", "outp", "outp", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld_d)   # diode load (vinp side)
    n.dev("MLDM", "outn", "outp", "vdd", "vdd", m_ld_m)   # mirror load (output side)
    n.dev("MCS", "out5", "outn", "vss", "vss", m_cs)
    Wn, Wp = p["Wn_inv"], p["Wp_inv"]
    n.M("MIVN", "vout", "out5", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, 0.15)
    n.M("MIVP", "vout", "out5", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gain1 = m_in_n.gm / (m_in_n.gds + m_ld_m.gds)
    gain2 = m_cs.gm / (m_cs.gds + m_cl.gds)

    # outn node: CS gate + pair drain + mirror drain
    C1 = m_cs.cgg + m_in_n.cdd + m_ld_m.cdd
    # out5 node: CS drain + load drain + inverter gate
    C2 = m_cs.cdd + m_cl.cdd + CG_PER_UM * (Wn + Wp)

    # Preamp linear ramp: outn must move ~50 mV to switch the CS stage, driven by gm*vod
    t1 = C1 * 0.05 / (m_in_p.gm * vod)
    # CS node slews ~0.25 V to the inverter threshold, driven by Ics
    t2 = C2 * 0.25 / Ics
    # Output inverter drives CL, limited by its own transient current
    t3 = cl * (VDD / 2) / (0.4e-3 * Wn)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    # Supply current: IREF + Itail + pb-sink branch (IREF) + CS load (Ics)
    power = VDD * iref * (2.0 + p["kt"] + p["kb"])

    # Systematic offset: CS gate DC level vs assumed mid-rail preamp output, referred to input
    offset = abs(m_cs.vgs - 0.9) / gain1

    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "offset": offset, "polarity_ok": 1}
```
